2607.02426.title: QFedAgent: Quantum-Enhanced Personalized Federated Learning for Multi-Agent Activity Recognition
2607.02426.paper_summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed devices without sharing raw data, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive robotic sensing applications. However, multi-agent systems generate heterogeneous and non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) multimodal sensor streams that degrade conventional FL algorithms, while classical fusion modules introduce substantial parameter overhead and communication cost. This paper proposes QFedAgent, a hybrid quantum-classical personalized FL framework for multi-agent activity recognition. The approach integrates a variational quantum circuit fusion module that models accelerometer--gyroscope interactions through quantum state encoding and entanglement, requiring only 72 quantum rotation parameters versus 33K in classical multi-layer perceptron-based fusion, achieving approximately 10x total parameter reduction. Experiments on the OPPORTUNITY dataset under subject-based non-IID partitions demonstrate 97.7% mean test accuracy, confirming that parameter-efficient quantum fusion remains competitive with conventional federated baselines.
2607.02426.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習（FL）使得在分佈式設備之間進行協作模型訓練成為可能，而無需共享原始數據，這使其適合隱私敏感的機器人感知應用。然而，多代理系統生成異質且非獨立同分佈（non-IID）的多模態傳感器流，這會降低傳統FL算法的效能，而傳統融合模塊則引入了大量的參數開銷和通信成本。本文提出了QFedAgent，一種混合量子-經典個性化FL框架，用於多代理活動識別。該方法整合了一個變分量子電路融合模塊，通過量子狀態編碼和糾纏來建模加速度計與陀螺儀之間的相互作用，僅需72個量子旋轉參數，而傳統多層感知器基礎的融合則需要33K，實現了約10倍的總參數減少。在基於主體的非IID劃分下對OPPORTUNITY數據集的實驗顯示，平均測試準確率達到97.7%，確認了參數高效的量子融合在與傳統聯邦基準的競爭中仍然具有競爭力。
